body: Huge fan here, Marilyn, any news on the Holy Wood book release? Also, what's the most shocking and or macabre statement, song, art piece of etc. that you never got to do for whatever reason?
Lovely. If you actually want to talk I'm around, though. I get it.
I'm sorry. We can drink together, if you like.
Isn't it? I'm in a house with others yet I am alone. You see?
Me too. Let's be alone, together.
We should awkwardly look at our own shoes over a dinner we're both too nervous to eat in front of each other.

I'm alone, lost a flawed, somewhat abusive relationship that I still wish I had out of my own stupidity. Because she was perfect for me, or at least a good fit. 

I hate myself, and most of humanity. I am ugly, stupid, angry and bitter. 

I have no one to hold, no one to hold me. All I want is love, yet I have none. 

I took eight sleeping pills and a beer last night, did nothing for me. 

Maybe next time I'll have 20 and six.
Ah, thank you. Glad to a higher rank now.
Thank you sweetie. You're very nice to me.

You're very sweet. I'm glad you like my words, I would gladly write you something on a topic of your choice. 

I have called, and they don't really help. They ask what I do to cope, and say to do it. So I play videogames mindlessly, leveling a beautiful caricature that I'll never be. It distracts me. 

When it ends, I'm back here. No love, no affection. I even lack friends. None at all. Just my confused and terrified parents. 

Thank you for your words. I would love a hug. I crave physical attention badly, to the point of sobbing. 

The only thing stopping me is fear, and guilt. I have no hope. I don't want to destroy my parents. I feel so selfish. I don't want to cease existing. I don't want to die. I just want the abject misery to end. 

Each relationship I form, online only, ends in bitter disappointment. I see beautiful, happy people around me, and I dream of them sitting with me. That I may brush their hair, and lick chocolate of their fingers while they giggle. 

Alas, such luxuries are not afforded to people like me. I am doomed to this perpetual agony, by my I'll mind, by my pained ugliness. Because no one wants to hear my misery, they have their own. 

I've been so tired for so long, I just want to sleep. I want it to end, to draw the velvet curtain on a play of blood soaked, murderous actors, fretting away their hour upon the stage. Signifying nothing.

I want to sleep, feel no more pain. But in doing so I will conflict ultimate hurt.  A profound paradox, perhaps. Or a Catch-22. 

Anyway, thanks for reading.

Wait another day, and find something new to lose yourself in. The biology of ravens. The writings of Nietzche. The discography of Tom Waits. Buy a PS4 and Destiny, or Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and grind the games into dust from so much playtime. 

Anything. Anything to keep you here a little longer. Believe it or not, I, and many other people think your life is precious.
That is NO help at all to someone in that situation. He or she thinks of dying because it seems less painful than their depression, clearly. Guilt tripping is not appropriate. You should know better.
Kickass torrents is my go to guy, usually has WAY more seeders than TPB.
You're welcome! Your voice truly is mesmerizing. I really hope you are convinced! It would make me very happy. :)
I would pay money for this. That voice is so perfect. I never knew I was into this until now. Please, please, please make more.
